description: Read one page of stored posts from an accessible Synoptic stream, newest first. Requires authentication and permission to read its posts; custom-target restrictions apply. Returns up to 50 posts with an optional continuation token. Use date bounds for historical updates or search_stream_posts for text queries. This call reads existing content and does not start monitoring or fetch external sources.

fromDate.description: Inclusive lower bound on post createdAt, as ISO 8601 with a timezone

id.description: Synoptic stream ID from search or streams_all

limit.description: Maximum number of posts in this page; defaults to 10

nextToken.description: Opaque token from the previous page; keep the stream and date bounds unchanged

toDate.description: Inclusive upper bound on post createdAt, as ISO 8601 with a timezone

name: get_stream_posts

items.description: Stored posts in this page, newest first

nextToken.description: Continuation token for older posts; omitted when this query has no further page

title: Read stream posts
